name: Truong Van Phuong
title: AI Engineer & Software Engineer
tagline: Architecting production AI/LLM systems, intelligent RAG pipelines, and high-performance distributed microservices.
bio: AI Engineer and Software Engineer with a solid foundation in core computer science, machine learning, and distributed software development. Experienced in building production-grade AI solutions, LLM applications, and multi-source RAG pipelines with chunk-level RBAC vector filtering, knowledge routing, and automated MLOps evaluation.

B.S. in Artificial Intelligence from FPT University (GPA 7.9/10). Strong engineering track record spanning enterprise Java backend microservices at FPT Software and high-throughput event-driven platforms with Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Netflix Eureka, and Docker—delivering resilient systems with sub-millisecond response times (~0.8ms).

education.thesis: AI-based smart cooking assistant for ingredient recognition and recipe recommendation, combining transformer-based computer vision models with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.
